extensionName.description: Add-on name in the Add-ons Manager.

extensionDescription.message: Flexible workspace prices by city, from the message or compose window. Sends the city slug to api.coworkingview.com. Does not read your messages.
extensionDescription.description: Short description in the Add-ons Manager.

buttonLabel.description: Label and tooltip of the message display and compose toolbar button.

refresh.description: Reloads prices for the selected city.

colSample.description: Table column for the number of observations.

loading.description: Status while a request is in flight.

workspaceCount.description: Catalogue size from meta.pagination.total. Not the price-index propertyCount.

workspaceUnavailable.message: The workspace count could not be loaded.
workspaceUnavailable.description: Shown when GET /v1/properties fails and the price table is still shown.

asOf.description: Price-index timestamp. RAW is the API asOf string, unchanged.

notPublished.description: Shown when a percentile is absent. Not a zero.

errorUnknownCity.message: That city is not in the published price index.
errorUnknownCity.description: The slug was not in data.cities.

errorBadCity.message: Enter a city slug such as berlin.

errorBadResponse.message: The API response could not be read.
errorBadResponse.description: Non-JSON body or a missing required field.

errorRateLimit.message: The API is rate limiting requests. Try again in a moment.

errorApi.description: Problem JSON detail from the API, unchanged.

attributionMissing.message: The response did not include the CC BY 4.0 attribution.
attributionMissing.description: Shown only when data.attribution is absent.

product_event_space.description: eventSpace aggregate, when the API publishes it.

product_virtual_office.description: virtualOffice aggregate, when the API publishes it.

unit_hour.description: Unit for a meeting room or event space.

optionsIntro.message: Choose the city the prices button opens with. You can still switch city in the popup.

optionsCityHelp.message: A catalogue slug, for example berlin or bad-homburg. This value is stored on this computer and sent as the city parameter to api.coworkingview.com.
optionsCityHelp.description: Explains what is stored and sent.

optionsCitiesLabel.description: Label for the city list from GET /v1/market/rates.

optionsPrivacyBody.message: The default city is stored only in Thunderbird on this computer. It is not synced. Opening the prices button sends that city slug and the interface language (en, de or es) to https://api.coworkingview.com as GET /v1/market/rates and GET /v1/properties (page 1, page size 1). The city list uses GET /v1/market/rates with the language only. No message, contact or account data is read or sent. The add-on does not set a cookie.
optionsPrivacyBody.description: Add-on privacy notice shown on the options page.

citiesUnavailable.message: The city list could not be loaded. You can still type a slug.
